title: Blessed Is That Fortunate Bride
summary: The shabad does not leave gratitude at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord
lifeApplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer
source.lifeApplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Let this line guide the first honest return after the reaction.
